Definition: to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to surround; 1a) (Qal) to surround; 2) to crown, give a crown; 2a) (Piel) to crown; 2b) (Hiphil) crown-bestower (participle)
